title: Add bounded autonomy growth snapshot history
summary: Add explicit bounded autonomy growth snapshot recording and read-only history projection support.
reason: The 30-day hardening plan calls for trend snapshots and growth-rate prediction. The safe next slice is an explicit diagnostics-state snapshot helper plus history-aware projection while keeping normal diagnostics reads side-effect free.
behavior_before: Autonomy growth projection reported current evidence only and had no bounded diagnostics-state snapshot history for rate estimates.
behavior_after: Autonomy growth projection can consume bounded snapshot history for rough growth estimates, and backend code has an explicit diagnostics-state-only helper to record capped snapshots without touching media, pending publish, queue, or cleanup behavior.
manual_validation: pytest tests/python/desktop/test_autonomy_health.py -q - initially failed before implementation (import error for missing growth history helpers)
pytest tests/python/desktop/test_autonomy_health.py -q - first implementation run failed on missing current free-space evidence in one test (1 failed, 13 passed)
refresh_summaries targeted autonomy growth history files - passed (4 written)

rollback_plan: Remove the growth snapshot history helpers, facade history loading, focused tests, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: Diagnostics state evidence only. This change must not write snapshots implicitly during ordinary health reads, rotate logs, clean files, mutate sources, drain pending publish, alter queue launch gating, or change media policy.
